SELECT B.POSITION_ID, B.PARENT_ID, B.POSTYPE_ID, B.ROLETYPE_ID, B.NAME, B.SNAME, B.CODE, B.ONAME, B.POS_FUNCTION, B.POS_RANK, B.POS_TYPE, B.EDITOR_TYPE, B.IS_EDITOR_CREATE, B.POS_NATURE, B.IS_PUB, B.IS_AGENT, B.IS_LEADER, B.LEADER_ID, B.MANAGE_DEPTIDS, B.IS_BIG_CONTACT, B.IS_SMALL_CONTACT, B.MOBILE_PHONE, B.OFFICE_PHONE, B.BUILDING_ID, B.ROOM_NO, B.EXT_QM_TYPE, B.EXT_QM_TYPE_PHOTO, B.EXT_POS_NAME, B.EXT_ORGAN_NAME, B.PRIORITY, B.PRIORITY_IN_ORGAN, B.PRIORITY_IN_DOMAIN, B.CREATOR_ID, B.CREATE_TIME, B.UPDATER_ID, B.UPDATE_TIME, B.LAST_TIME, B.DEL_FLAG, B.DESCRIPTION, B.REMARK FROM SYS_POSITION B WHERE 1=1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SYS_POSITION B WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT B.POSITION_ID, B.PARENT_ID, B.POSTYPE_ID, B.ROLETYPE_ID, B.NAME, B.SNAME, B.CODE, B.ONAME, B.POS_FUNCTION, B.POS_RANK, B.POS_TYPE, B.EDITOR_TYPE, B.IS_EDITOR_CREATE, B.POS_NATURE, B.IS_PUB, B.IS_AGENT, B.IS_LEADER, B.LEADER_ID, B.MANAGE_DEPTIDS, B.IS_BIG_CONTACT, B.IS_SMALL_CONTACT, B.MOBILE_PHONE, B.OFFICE_PHONE, B.BUILDING_ID, B.ROOM_NO, B.EXT_QM_TYPE, B.EXT_QM_TYPE_PHOTO, B.EXT_POS_NAME, B.EXT_ORGAN_NAME, B.PRIORITY, B.PRIORITY_IN_ORGAN, B.PRIORITY_IN_DOMAIN, B.CREATOR_ID, B.CREATE_TIME, B.UPDATER_ID, B.UPDATE_TIME, B.LAST_TIME, B.DEL_FLAG, B.DESCRIPTION, B.REMARK , POS.NAME as parentName , ROLETYPE.NAME as roletypeName , POSTYPE.NAME as postypeName FROM SYS_POSITION B
WHERE 1=1
mapper.sql: left join SYS_POSITION POS on B.PARENT_ID = POS.POSITION_ID left join CORE_ROLETYPE ROLETYPE on B.ROLETYPE_ID = ROLETYPE.ROLETYPE_ID left join CORE_POSTYPE POSTYPE on B.POSTYPE_ID = POSTYPE.POSTYPE_ID

SELECT B.POSITION_ID, B.PARENT_ID, B.POSTYPE_ID, B.ROLETYPE_ID, B.NAME, B.SNAME, B.CODE, B.ONAME, B.POS_FUNCTION, B.POS_RANK, B.POS_TYPE, B.EDITOR_TYPE, B.IS_EDITOR_CREATE, B.POS_NATURE, B.IS_PUB, B.IS_AGENT, B.IS_LEADER, B.LEADER_ID, B.MANAGE_DEPTIDS, B.IS_BIG_CONTACT, B.IS_SMALL_CONTACT, B.MOBILE_PHONE, B.OFFICE_PHONE, B.BUILDING_ID, B.ROOM_NO, B.EXT_QM_TYPE, B.EXT_QM_TYPE_PHOTO, B.EXT_POS_NAME, B.EXT_ORGAN_NAME, B.PRIORITY, B.PRIORITY_IN_ORGAN, B.PRIORITY_IN_DOMAIN, B.CREATOR_ID, B.CREATE_TIME, B.UPDATER_ID, B.UPDATE_TIME, B.LAST_TIME, B.DEL_FLAG, B.DESCRIPTION, B.REMARK , POS.NAME as parentName , ROLETYPE.NAME as roletypeName , POSTYPE.NAME as postypeName FROM SYS_POSITION B
WHERE POSITION_ID = #{value}

select ROLETYPE.ROLETYPE_ID as id, NULL as parentId, 1 as isRoleType, ROLETYPE.NAME as name, ROLETYPE.PRIORITY as priority from CORE_ROLETYPE ROLETYPE where ROLETYPE.DEL_FLAG = 0
AND NAME like concat('%',#{key},'%')
union all select POS.POSITION_ID as id, POS.ROLETYPE_ID as parentId, 0 as isRoleType, POS.NAME as name, POS.PRIORITY as priority from SYS_POSITION POS where 1=1
AND POS.POSTYPE_ID = #{postypeId}
AND NAME like concat('%',#{key},'%')
ORDER BY PRIORITY ASC

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT B.POSITION_ID,B.PARENT_ID,B.NAME,E.ROLE_ID,F.ROLETYPE_ID FROM SYS_POSITION B LEFT JOIN SYS_ROLE_POSITION D ON B.POSITION_ID = D.POSITION_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_ROLE E ON E.ROLE_ID = D.ROLE_ID LEFT JOIN CORE_ROLETYPE F ON F.ROLETYPE_ID = E.ROLETYPE_ID where 1=1 AND B.POSITION_ID = #{positionId}
SELECT NAME as name, POSITION_ID as cddValue FROM SYS_POSITION B WHERE B.DEL_FLAG = 0 ORDER BY PRIORITY ASC

select B.ROLETYPE_ID AS id, B.NAME AS label, B.ROLETYPE_ID AS searchCode
, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SYS_POSITION WHERE ROLETYPE_ID = B.ROLETYPE_ID AND POSITION_ID = #{positionId}) AS checked
from CORE_ROLETYPE B where B.DEL_FLAG = 0 and B.ROLETYPE_ID=#{roletypeId} order by B.PRIORITY asc
select count(*) from SYS_ROLE B WHERE B.ROLETYPE_ID = #{roletypeId}

select B.ROLE_ID AS id, B.NAME AS label,CONCAT(B.ROLETYPE_ID,CONCAT(',',B.ROLE_ID)) AS searchCode
,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SYS_ROLE_POSITION WHERE ROLE_ID = B.ROLE_ID AND POSITION_ID = #{positionId}) AS checked
from SYS_ROLE B where B.ROLETYPE_ID = #{roletypeId} order by B.PRIORITY asc
select count(*) from SYS_ROLE_POSITION B WHERE B.ROLE_ID = #{roleId}

select B.POSITION_ID AS id, B.NAME AS label
,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SYS_POSITION WHERE POSITION_ID = B.POSITION_ID and POSITION_ID = #{positionId}) AS checked
from SYS_POSITION B left join SYS_ROLE_POSITION C ON B.POSITION_ID = C.POSITION_ID where C.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} and B.PARENT_ID is null order by B.PRIORITY asc
select count(*) from SYS_POSITION B WHERE B.PARENT_ID = #{positionId}
select count(*) from SYS_POSITION B WHERE B.PARENT_ID = #{positionId}

select B.POSITION_ID AS id, B.NAME AS label
,(SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SYS_POSITION WHERE POSITION_ID = B.POSITION_ID and POSITION_ID = #{positionId}) AS checked
from SYS_POSITION B where B.PARENT_ID is null and B.ROLETYPE_ID = #{roletypeId}
AND B.NAME like concat('%',concat(#{q},'%'))
order by B.PRIORITY asc
